sessions.phase_label: Main, sensor, and LED board specification and design
Multi-board production files and manufacturing preparation

requirements.title: I2C Bus Electrical Configuration
requirements.definition: The inter-board I2C buses must support the specified cable lengths, speed, pull-up values, and optional edge-damping resistors.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers shared I2C electrical behavior; sensor-specific connector routing and SPS30 mode selection are separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Interboard Power and Signal Links
requirements.definition: Power, signal, and USB-related interboard connections must use compatible connector families, pin assignments, and matching physical numbering.
requirements.boundary_note: Treats the matching interboard interface as one mechanism; individual battery, sensor-module, and panel connectors remain separate.

requirements.title: Board-Chain Power Distribution
requirements.definition: The power board must feed the main board, which must consume and forward the 3.3V and 5V rails to the sensor board.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers rail flow through the three-board chain, not current metering or connector part selection.

requirements.title: Panel Power Control
requirements.definition: A panel-mounted momentary control must reach the AXP2101 PWRON signal so the system can be switched on and off.
requirements.boundary_note: The PWRON control is independent of general GPIO buttons, reset, and touch inputs.

requirements.title: Power-Board TVS ESD Protection
requirements.definition: The power board must include the accepted TVS-based electrostatic-discharge protection.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers TVS ESD protection only; battery thermal safety and USB data protection are independent.

requirements.title: Battery Safety and Temperature Monitoring
requirements.definition: The power system must provide the agreed battery protection behavior and expose battery temperature sensing through NTC.
requirements.boundary_note: Safety behavior is separate from the physical battery connector family and placement.

requirements.title: Power-Board Battery Interface
requirements.definition: The battery must connect through the specified JST-PH interface with correct power, ground, NTC, pinout, labels, and accessible placement.
requirements.boundary_note: Connector identity, pinout, and placement form one battery interface; battery protection behavior is separate.

requirements.title: Switched 5V Boost Supply
requirements.definition: The MT3608 boost converter must power periodic 5V loads only when enabled by the controller and must default off through an EN pull-down.
requirements.boundary_note: GPIO assignment and pull-down value are attributes of the same independently switchable 5V mechanism.

requirements.title: Power-Board USB-C Connector
requirements.definition: The power-board USB-C connector must support the required data lines and use a readily obtainable, replaceable part.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers connector capability and sourcing, not integrated-board native USB enumeration.

requirements.title: Power-Board Mechanical Layout
requirements.definition: The power PCB must satisfy the compact shape, mounting-hole, orientation, connector-spacing, USB-edge, and enclosure-fit constraints.
requirements.boundary_note: Mechanical placement constraints are grouped as one board-fit mechanism; connector electrical pinouts remain separate.

requirements.title: Power-Board Layer Stack
requirements.definition: The power board must use the selected layer count and grounding strategy to support low-noise AXP2101 routing.
requirements.boundary_note: Layer count and dedicated grounding are attributes of one fabrication-stack decision.

requirements.title: Power-Board AXP2101 Topology
requirements.definition: The AXP2101 VMID, VSYS, switch-node, thermal, and related reference-design connections must be electrically correct and reviewable.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers core AXP2101 schematic and layout topology; output-voltage policy and manufactured runtime stability are separate.

requirements.title: Power-Board DCDC1 Output Setpoint
requirements.definition: AXP2101 DCDC1 must be configured to compensate for downstream diode loss and provide the intended 3.3V system rail.
requirements.boundary_note: The programmed setpoint is independent of the integrated board's later transient-regulation failures.

requirements.title: Battery-Charge Status Output
requirements.definition: Battery-charge state must be made available to the system LED indication circuit without requiring an unnecessary separate indicator LED.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the CHGLED/status interface, not the visual LED-array implementation.

requirements.title: Main-Board Standalone USB Power
requirements.definition: When the power board is absent, USB-C and an adequately rated LDO must power the complete 3.3V rail for programming and sensor debugging.
requirements.boundary_note: Standalone USB power is independently testable from normal AXP2101-powered operation.

requirements.title: Main-Board Power Source OR-ing
requirements.definition: The main board must combine power-board and USB-derived 3.3V sources safely through suitable diode OR-ing components.
requirements.boundary_note: Source selection and isolation are separate from LDO capacity and rail-current measurement.

requirements.title: Main-Board Rail Current Monitoring
requirements.definition: The main board must meter total downstream current on both 3.3V and 5V rails using an appropriate multi-channel monitor and shunts.
requirements.boundary_note: Monitor IC, shunt resistance, package size, and series placement are attributes of one metering mechanism.

requirements.title: Main-Board ESP32 GPIO Assignments
requirements.definition: All main-board functions must use GPIOs exposed and suitable on the selected ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 module.
requirements.boundary_note: Individual pin assignments are attributes of the shared mapping; panel-control electrical topology is separate.

requirements.title: Main-Board Panel Controls and Inputs
requirements.definition: Panel buttons, switch, reset, and touch inputs must connect through the specified headers, while only the development BOOT button is board-mounted.
requirements.boundary_note: Groups the panel-input connector mechanism; PWRON is a separate power-control Requirement.

requirements.title: Main-Board Connector Inventory
requirements.definition: The main board must include the complete specified set of JST and USB connectors for all attached boards, sensors, controls, display, LEDs, and programming.
requirements.boundary_note: Completeness of the connector set is separate from board-fit layout and each interface's pinout.

requirements.title: Main-Board I2C Signal Conditioning
requirements.definition: Optional I2C series resistors must be retained or omitted consistently and, when present, placed directly beside the ESP32 pins before the pull-ups and devices.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers main-board series-resistor topology; shared pull-up values and cable behavior belong to the bus-level Requirement.

requirements.title: Main-Board Mechanical Layout
requirements.definition: The main board must fit its components and individual connectors while satisfying enclosure orientation, top-edge access, alignment, and connector-orientation constraints.
requirements.boundary_note: Board dimensions and connector placement form one layout mechanism; full ESP32 pin breakout is independently required.

requirements.title: Main-Board ESP32 Full-Pin Breakout
requirements.definition: The main board must expose all usable ESP32-S3 module pins through a compact through-hole breakout suitable for reuse as a generic base platform.
requirements.boundary_note: Full pin access and header pitch are one breakout mechanism, independent of functional GPIO assignments.

requirements.title: Main-Board Switched 3.3V Load Circuit
requirements.definition: The main board must switch the positive 3.3V load rail using a suitable high-side transistor arrangement rather than incorrectly switching ground.
requirements.boundary_note: The transistor pair is an independent power-switch mechanism, not part of LED logic-level translation.

requirements.title: Main-Board Passive Buzzer
requirements.definition: The main board must support the accepted passive SMD buzzer or an equivalent suitable part.
requirements.boundary_note: Buzzer type and selected part are attributes of one audible-output mechanism.

requirements.title: Main-Board Addressable-LED Power and Logic
requirements.definition: Addressable LEDs must receive the selected supply voltage, suitable data-level handling, and switchable power to avoid standby drain.
requirements.boundary_note: Supply, level shifting, and standby-power control are tightly coupled for this LED interface; the separate LED-board array is independent.

requirements.title: Main-Board Local Decoupling
requirements.definition: The ESP32, AXP2101, MT3608, and other sensitive devices must have electrically adequate local decoupling placement.
requirements.boundary_note: Decoupling adequacy is independently reviewable from overall rail regulation and current-path width.

requirements.title: Sensor-Board Connector Topology
requirements.definition: The sensor board must include the specified main-board inputs and individual output connectors with the required families, pitches, pinouts, and count.
requirements.boundary_note: Connector completeness and pinouts form one sensor-interface mechanism; physical layout and level shifting are separate.

requirements.title: Sensor-Board Logic-Level Handling
requirements.definition: The current sensor board must omit unnecessary onboard level-shifter circuitry because all selected sensors use compatible 3.3V logic.
requirements.boundary_note: Future incompatible sensors may use an adapter board; that contingency does not require permanent footprints now.

requirements.title: SPS30 I2C Mode Selection
requirements.definition: The SPS30 SEL pin must be hardwired to ground so the sensor starts and remains in I2C mode.
requirements.boundary_note: This is an independently testable sensor-mode behavior rather than a generic connector attribute.

requirements.title: Sensor-Board Mechanical Layout
requirements.definition: The sensor board must fit all required components and connectors while preserving the agreed access orientation and minimizing inaccessible bottom-side placement.
requirements.boundary_note: Physical fit and orientation are separate from connector completeness and sensor electrical behavior.

requirements.title: Addressable LED Board Array
requirements.definition: The LED PCB must implement the requested addressable RGBW LED array using the confirmed package and appropriate center-to-center spacing.
requirements.boundary_note: LED model, package, count, and spacing are attributes of the same array; connector pinout is separate.

requirements.title: LED-Board Power and Data Pinout
requirements.definition: The LED board must expose the correct supply, ground, and data connections with pin numbering matching the main board.
requirements.boundary_note: Pinout correctness can fail independently of LED part selection and physical spacing.

requirements.title: Power-Board Production Package
requirements.definition: The power board must have a complete and internally consistent BOM and manufacturing-file package suitable for quotation and assembly.
requirements.boundary_note: Separated from other boards because its BOM and exports can be completed or fail independently.

requirements.title: Main-Board Production Package
requirements.definition: The main board must have accurate component records, BOM entries, position data, and fabrication outputs.
requirements.boundary_note: Main-board production data is independently reviewable from sensor- and power-board deliverables.

requirements.title: Sensor-Board Production Package
requirements.definition: The sensor board must include its own correct BOM, Gerbers, NPTH and PTH drill files, and pick-and-place data.
requirements.boundary_note: This package had a board-specific wrong-BOM and missing-export trajectory, so it remains separate.

requirements.title: Integrated-Board Production Package
requirements.definition: The integrated board must be delivered with a complete BOM, component positions, fabrication files, and current design revision for quotation and manufacture.
requirements.boundary_note: The integrated design has its own revision and BOM lifecycle independent of the earlier multi-board packages.

requirements.title: Portable KiCad Project Libraries
requirements.definition: Project libraries and 3D models must be included and referenced portably so the project opens correctly across machines and supported KiCad versions.
requirements.boundary_note: File-path and library portability is an executable-artifact requirement, not generic documentation.

requirements.title: Component Sourceability
requirements.definition: Selected components and connectors must be obtainable in practical quantities, with acceptable alternatives when stock or minimum-order constraints arise.
requirements.boundary_note: Sourceability is a cross-cutting component constraint; it does not own each interface's electrical behavior.

requirements.title: Manufacturing Account and Cart Setup
requirements.definition: The board projects must be uploaded or restored in the manufacturing account with assembly options, parts, and order data configured for client review.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a requested operational deliverable, distinct from merely advising the client how to order.

requirements.title: Assembly Component-Orientation Review
requirements.definition: Component placement and orientation must be checked in the manufacturing preview before production approval.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a concrete manufacturing acceptance condition rather than generic QA.

requirements.title: Board Identification and Pin Markings
requirements.definition: Boards must carry the required connector-pin labels, identification marks, and QR code without obstructing mechanical or electrical features.
requirements.boundary_note: Combines markings rendered on the PCB; lead-free material compliance is separate.

requirements.title: Lead-Free Assembly
requirements.definition: Every manufactured board must use the requested lead-free assembly option.
requirements.boundary_note: Lead-free compliance can change independently of board markings and QR codes.

requirements.title: Single Integrated Board Architecture
requirements.definition: The functions of the separate power, main, and sensor boards must be consolidated onto one PCB while preserving required system functionality.
requirements.boundary_note: Defines the board architecture only; individual retained functions remain separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Integrated-Board Cost Optimization
requirements.definition: The integrated design must reduce manufacturing cost through fewer connectors, simpler circuitry, and Basic-category parts where practical without losing functionality.
requirements.boundary_note: Cost optimization is independent of the architectural decision to use one board and may change individual component choices.

requirements.title: Integrated-Board Power Management
requirements.definition: The integrated board must efficiently power 3.3V and 5V loads, charge the battery while operating, support operation from USB without a battery, and retain AXP2101 unless a superior solution is accepted.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers source and rail-management behavior; DCDC1 transient regulation, routing capacity, and assembly quality are independently testable.

requirements.title: Integrated-Board Current Monitoring
requirements.definition: The integrated design must provide the required current-measurement capability while omitting a separate INA device if AXP2101 can reliably supply equivalent measurements.
requirements.boundary_note: The final implementation choice remains conditional, but the measurement behavior is independently required.

requirements.title: E-Paper Display Backlight Circuit
requirements.definition: The integrated board must provide a PWM-controlled external display-light output with safe boot behavior, supply selection, decoupling, and future 3.3V compatibility.
requirements.boundary_note: PWM switch, pull-down, supply jumpers, capacitor, and DNP resistor are attributes of one backlight mechanism.

requirements.title: Display Light-Sensor Port
requirements.definition: The integrated board must provide an additional I2C JST connector for the display's ambient-light sensor.
requirements.boundary_note: The light-sensor interface can be added or removed independently of the backlight driver.

requirements.title: Integrated-Board Connector Assembly Type
requirements.definition: The integrated development boards must use through-hole connectors throughout despite their higher assembly cost.
requirements.boundary_note: Through-hole versus SMD is an assembly-technology decision separate from connector count and pinout.

requirements.title: Integrated-Board ESP32 Breakout
requirements.definition: The integrated board must preserve accessible ESP32-S3 pin headers using the corrected 1.27mm pitch.
requirements.boundary_note: This is the integrated-version breakout requirement and should not be merged with the completed separate main-board artifact.

requirements.title: Integrated-Board Mechanical and Connector Layout
requirements.definition: The integrated PCB must use a case-compatible orientation and connector placement with accessible battery and USB connectors, grouped display interfaces, and adequate ESP32 antenna clearance.
requirements.boundary_note: Combines mutually coupled board-orientation and edge-placement constraints; connector inventory and electrical behavior remain separate.

requirements.title: Integrated-Board Peripheral Connector Set
requirements.definition: The integrated board must contain every required connector for sensors, display, LEDs, controls, battery, and other external peripherals.
requirements.boundary_note: Connector completeness is independently reviewable from connector assembly type and physical placement.

requirements.title: Integrated-Board Native USB Programming
requirements.definition: Native USB must enumerate and support flashing in normal and forced-download modes while retaining correctly wired USBLC6 ESD protection.
requirements.boundary_note: USB enumeration, D+/D- routing, and ESD pass-through form one acceptance behavior; general power regulation is separate.

requirements.title: Integrated-Board Button and Switch Inputs
requirements.definition: Buttons 3 and 4 and the slide switch must use active-low inputs with 3.3V pull-ups, while PIR and touch inputs retain appropriate pull-downs.
requirements.boundary_note: Groups the electrical biasing of external digital inputs; the PWRON control remains separate.

requirements.title: AXP2101 Auxiliary and Backup Pins
requirements.definition: Unused AXP2101 auxiliary signals must be handled deliberately, with VRTC left appropriately unused and VBACKUP and PWROK exposed for future backup and debugging.
requirements.boundary_note: VRTC, VBACKUP, and PWROK are grouped as auxiliary/testability provisions, separate from DCDC1 regulation.

requirements.title: Integrated-Board High-Current Routing
requirements.definition: VBUS, battery, and 5V current paths must avoid unsafe narrow bottlenecks and provide adequate copper pours and stitching for worst-case current.
requirements.boundary_note: Current-carrying copper capacity can be verified independently of PMIC regulation and component selection.

requirements.title: Integrated-Board DCDC1 Regulation and Load Stability
requirements.definition: AXP2101 DCDC1 must provide the configured 3.3V-class output and remain stable through ESP32 boot, flash, WiFi, and other expected load transients.
requirements.boundary_note: This is the runtime acceptance behavior implicated by the rail-collapse trajectory; manufacturing cause hypotheses remain evidence rather than separate functional requirements.

requirements.title: AXP2101 Assembly Reliability
requirements.definition: AXP2101 assembly must use handling, paste, reflow, and inspection practices that prevent moisture damage, package lifting, shorts, and poor production yield.
requirements.boundary_note: Manufacturing-process reliability is separate from the electrical requirement that DCDC1 regulate correctly.

requirements.title: Enclosure Component Capacity
requirements.definition: The enclosure must accommodate the PCB system, battery, display, sensors, and related hardware.
requirements.boundary_note: Capacity is separate from mounting security, airflow, and display-cover behavior.

requirements.title: Enclosure Display Integration
requirements.definition: The cover must provide the selected display cutout and allow the display and cover to be installed and connected easily.
requirements.boundary_note: Display mounting can evolve independently of airflow and internal board supports.

requirements.title: Enclosure Mounting and Drop Retention
requirements.definition: Boards and batteries must have secure base mounts that keep all components in place during normal handling and drops.
requirements.boundary_note: Mechanical retention is independently testable from basic component capacity.

requirements.title: Enclosure Sensor Airflow
requirements.definition: The enclosure must admit air below the sensors and exhaust it through the top.
requirements.boundary_note: Airflow has its own input/output acceptance path and should not be reduced to a generic enclosure attribute.

requirements.title: Enclosure LED Light Path
requirements.definition: The enclosure must provide a visible light path for the LED array through a translucent strip or suitable grid.
requirements.boundary_note: This optical enclosure behavior is independent of the LED board's electrical implementation.

unresolved_candidates.description: The accepted VMID/VSYS trace-cut and DNP-capacitor test provision was later discouraged due to space and complexity; it is unclear whether any final hardware provision remained.
The integrated design may omit the INA monitor if AXP2101 provides sufficient current measurements, but the final capability decision is not explicitly confirmed.
Evidence supports an AXP2101 assembly-reliability concern, but it is uncertain whether a windowpane paste-aperture change became a confirmed PCB requirement or remained only a diagnostic hypothesis.
The enclosure requirements are concrete, but the enclosure was discussed as a possible separate project and may not have entered the active contracted scope.
The freelancer claimed the USB correction was fixed, but the supplied history does not clearly confirm that the corrected symbol separates U3 pin 2 and pin 5 or that ERC and DRC passed.
